parsed.claim: The bespoke Sofic class is satisfiable: the trivial group Unit is Sofic, using a one-point permutation model with trivial action. The multiplicativity defect is 0 < ε, and the separation condition is vacuous since Unit has no non-identity element. So the definition is not unsatisfiable.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_sofic_unit : SoficGroups.Sofic Unit := by
  refine ⟨fun F ε hε _ => ⟨⟨1, one_pos, fun _ => 1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  constructor
  · intro g _ h _
    simp [SoficGroups.normalizedHamming, hε]
  · intro g _ hg
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim g 1) hg
